posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina is serving major summer fashion goals with her yellow looks and is reportedly set to reunite with Ranbir Kapoor for Raajneeti 2.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' with Imtiaz Ali is creating buzz, and he's announced a new leg of his Born to Shine world tour with record-breaking ticket sales.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia's spy thriller 'Alpha' with Sharvari has been preponed to July 3 — she plays an assassin in YRF's first female-led spy universe film.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka made a whirlwind Mumbai visit of under 12 hours, sharing 'Phir Milenge' as she jetted off, while posting cherished moments with Malti and Nick.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's 'King' is nearing completion for a Christmas 2026 release, featuring Suhana's debut alongside Deepika and Anil Kapoor in the action thriller.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena enters her 'padel era' and wraps the shoot of 'Daayra' with Prithviraj Sukumaran, while being eyed for Salman Khan's Raj-DK superhero film.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha reportedly suffered a fracture while shooting 'Eetha,' pausing filming as anticipation builds for her Stree and Bhediya franchise sequels.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is filming 'Raka' with Allu Arjun using a body double for action during her second pregnancy, and dropped hints about her exit from Vanga's 'Spirit.'

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer's Don 3 exit has escalated with an FWICE non-cooperation directive, but he's moving ahead — 'Pralay' begins filming in August amid the industry drama.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Madhuri Dixit defended Aishwarya after criticism of her Cannes look, as the former Miss World also secured court protection against AI-generated deepfakes.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika is the talk of town with 'Cocktail 2' promotions alongside Shahid Kapoor, and has reunited with Vijay Deverakonda for period action drama 'Rana Baali.'

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha continues to focus on her acting career and production ventures as ex-husband Naga Chaitanya fights AI deepfakes in Delhi High Court.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's next film 'Raka' with director Atlee is generating massive buzz, with Deepika Padukone joining as a warrior princess co-lead.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's 'Peddi' with Janhvi Kapoor hits theaters on June 4 — the pan-India entertainer is his most ambitious project since RRR.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's Bollywood debut 'War 2' with Hrithik Roshan has received Rs 100 crore offers for Telugu states ahead of its August 14 release.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi's 'Peddi' with Ram Charan arrives June 4, and she responded to 'Hellallallo' being called vulgar — Ram Charan backed her all the way.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya turned heads with her all-white ethnic look at a recent Mumbai event that went viral, continuing her evolution as a Bollywood fashion icon.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara stars alongside Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR in YRF's spy thriller 'War 2,' arriving in theaters August 14 as the franchise's biggest entry yet.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik wrapped 'War 2' with Jr NTR for an August 14 release, and has been approached for a cameo in 'Jailer 2' after SRK opted out.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's rom-com 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' faces a Rs 400 crore lawsuit from Vashu Bhagnani over the Chunnari Chunnari remake ahead of its June release.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya has been prolific in 2026 with tracks for AR Rahman's 'Gandhi Talks,' Pritam's 'Bhooth Bangla,' and Ajay-Atul's 'Raja Shivaji.'

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman is headlining 'Haazri 2026' alongside Sonu Nigam, Hariharan, and Shaan — a historic reunion honoring guru Ustad Ghulam Mustafa Khan.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay was sworn in as Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister on May 10 after TVK's historic 108-seat win, and his final film 'Jana Nayagan' releases this month.
